as_told.title: L'Espresso article on Trump taking control of special access programs

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in July 2025 the Italian magazine L'Espresso published an article that discusses something called Project Preserve Destiny in connection with President Donald Trump. In a later episode he describes the same article as resting on a confidential source and claiming that Trump was taking control of special access programs, the most secret and tightly restricted military projects, away from the Pentagon. If true, it would mean the White House was moving to take charge of hidden programs.
